source: 609 Useful Armor
target: 609 Armatura Utilis

source: Lumian shot a quick smile at Lugano and fixed his gaze on the Pride Armor, carefully observing its reaction.
target: Lumian Lugano celeriter subridit et oculos in Armaturam Superbiae defixit, reactionem eius diligenter observans.

source: “What experiment? To test the effects of this armor?” Lugano questioned, a mix of apprehension and confusion in his voice.
target: “Quid experimentum? Ad experimentandum effectus huius armaturae?” interrogavit Lugano, voce sollicita et confusa.

source: As soon as he finished speaking, the air on the dark deck, bathed in the crimson moonlight, suddenly solidified.
target: Statim postquam locutus est, aer in obscuro ponte, lumine rubro lunae immersus, subito solidificatus est.

source: In the next instant, the empty armor produced a radiant broadsword, and an unseen force locked onto Lugano.
target: In momento sequenti, armatura vacua gladium radiantem produxit, et vis invisibilis ad Lugano se adligavit.

source: Wh… Before Lugano could react, the silver-white full-body armor surged forward, the gleaming broadsword poised to strike.
target: Heu… Priusquam Lugano responderet, armatura totius corporis argenteo-alba surrexit, gladium radiante ad ictum paratum.

source: In a split second, Lumian positioned himself in front of Lugano.
target: In momento brevissimo, Lumian coram Lugano se posuit.

source: His body expanded abruptly, almost tearing his linen shirt and black pants.
target: Corpus eius repente dilatatum est, paene tunicam linteam et bracas negras lacerans.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: Lumian’s massive fist collided with the Sword of Dawn, creating a metallic clang that resonated through the air.
target: Magnus pugnus Lumiani cum Gladio Auroris concurrit, creando clangorem metallicum per aerem resonantem.

source: Only then did Lugano shake off his bewilderment.
target: Tum demum Lugano stuporem suum delevit.

source: Though unsure why the empty armor attacked him, he instinctively turned and sprinted away.
target: Quamquam nescius erat cur armatura vacua eum oppugnarit, se instanter vertit et festinanter fugit.

source: After covering some ground, the Pride Armor halted and stood silently.
target: Post viam aliquantam percursam, Armatura Superbiae subsedit et silentiose stetit.

source: The Sword of Dawn, fashioned from light, dissipated, turning into beams of light that dispersed the crimson moonlight, casting a dawn-like ambiance upon the dark deck.
target: Gladius Auroris, ex luce factus, evanuit, in radios lucis transmutatus, qui lumen rubrum lunae dispergebant atque ambitum aurorae similem super obscuram pontem iaciebant.

source: This sensation vanished in the blink of an eye.
target: Haec sensatio in ictu oculi evanuit.

source: Lumian, not daring to turn his back on the Pride Armor, repositioned himself and gauged the distance between the armor and Lugano.
target: Lumian, non audens terga convertere ad Armaturam Superbiae, se iterum posuit et distantiam inter armaturam et Lugano metitus est.

source: About 20 meters… factoring in Lugano’s running speed, the sensing range is approximately 15 meters… Lumian swiftly concluded.
target: Circa viginti metra… consideratis celeritate Luganoi currentis, spatium sensuum fere quindecim metris esse censitum est… Lumian celeriter conclusit.

source: His body reverted to its original form, and a confident smile returned to his face.
target: Corpus eius ad formam originalem rediit, et risus fidus in facie eius rediit.

source: It was enough. A fifteen-meter range sufficed on the ship!
target: Satis erat. Ambitus quindecim metrorum in nave suffecit!

source: He stowed away the Pride Armor and addressed Lugano, who was still making his way to the bow, “The experiment is over.”
target: Armaturam Superbiae recondidit et Lugano adloquitur, qui adhuc ad proram navigii se ferebat, “Experimentum finitum est.”

source: Huh? Lugano came to a sudden halt, realizing that Lumian had already stashed the peculiar silver-white full-body armor back into the mystical item cleverly disguised as a coin bag.
target: Heu? Lugano subito subsistit, intellegens Lumian iam pecularem armaturam totius corporis argenteo-albam in rem mysticam, callide simulatam ut sacculum nummorum, reconditam esse.

source: Relieved, he jogged back, curiosity etched on his face as he inquired, “Did the experiment succeed?”
target: Levatus, rediit currendo, vultu curiositate notato, interrogans, “Experimentum successitne?”

source: “Very successful,” Lumian replied, sporting a radiant smile.
target: “Valde prosperum,” respondit Lumian, subridens radiante.

source: Though Lugano didn’t grasp the experiment’s significance, he had a hunch that Lumian might be exploring a way to locate Father Montserrat.
target: Quamquam Lugano significationem experimenti non perspexit, innuit Lumian viam quaerendi Patrem Montserrat esse.

source: Upon reaching the first-class suite, Lumian promptly instructed Lugano, “Go to the captain and ask him to gather all the Beyonders of the Earth pathway on the ship. Oh, and the Beyonders of the Apothecary pathway. I’ll be back after capturing Father Montserrat. It doesn’t matter if they don’t show up. They’ll bear the risk themselves.”
target: Ad conclave primae classe, Lumian statim Lugano instruxit: “Ad capitaneum vade et roga eum ut omnes Beyonders semitae Terrae in nave congreget. Et etiam Beyonders semitae Apothecarii. Redebo post Patrem Montserrat ceperim. Nihil refert, si non appareant. Ipsi periculum ferent.”

source: Unsure if Captain Pedro was aware of every unstable element on the ship and every Beyonder, Lumian planned to monitor the Pride Armor later to prevent it from targeting hidden wild Beyonders.
target: Nescius an Capitanus Pedro de omnibus instabilibus elementis in nave et omni Beyonder conscius esset, Lumian consilium cepit postea Armaturam Superbiae vigilandum esse, ne Beyonders feros occulti oppigerent.

source: Allowing Pedro to handle this process first would lighten his load.
target: Permittens Petro hunc processum primum curare, onus eius levabitur.

source: As Lugano left the suite, Lumian turned to Ludwig, who had resumed his meal.
target: Dum Lugano conclave reliquit, Lumian ad Ludwig conversus est, qui cibum suum iterum capiebat.

source: “Keep an eye out later and see if there’s any ‘food’ secretly lurking here.”
target: “Postea exspice et vide, utrum quidam ‘cibus’ hic occulte lateat.”

source: Ludwig, mouth full of cake, signaled his agreement.
target: Ludwig, ore pleno placentae, consensum suum indicavit.

source: Waiting for the captain’s arrival, Lumian patrolled the cabin’s top floor with the Pride Armor in his arms, but Father Montserrat remained elusive.
target: Captani adventum exspectans, Lumian summum tabulatum cellae pervagatus est, cum Armaturam Superbiae in brachiis, sed Pater Montserrat manebat elusivus.

source: Before long, Pedro entered the suite with the suspected security supervisor and a passenger in a low hat.
target: Mox, Pedro conclave intravit cum suspecto praefecto securitatis et viatore galea humilem gestante.

source: Lumian didn’t delve into details and gestured toward the sofa.
target: Lumian non in subtilitates intravit et ad sofa signum dedit.

source: “Wait for me here.”
target: “Exspecta me hic.”

source: Without waiting for a response, he pressed down on his golden straw hat and exited the room.
target: Nullo responsum expectans, pileum aureum stramineum deprimens, conclave egreditur.

source: Upon reaching the staircase, Lumian “pulled” out his silver-white full-body armor.
target: Ad scalas perveniens, Lumian armaturam totius corporis argenteo-albam extraxit.

source: Gripping the Sealed Artifact’s armpits firmly with both hands, he methodically patrolled each level of the cabin.
target: Utrisque manibus axillas Artifacti Sigillati firme prehendens, methodice singulos gradus cellae pervagatus est.

source: Whenever he approached a distance less than 15 meters from his suite, Lumian exercised extra caution, yet the Pride Armor refrained from attacking anyone.
target: Quotienscumque ad distantiam minus quam quindecim metra a sua suite appropinquaret, Lumian cautelam additam adhibebat, sed Armatura Superbiae a quolibet oppugnare cessavit.

source: Could it be that, beyond five meters and with several layers of obstruction, the armor wouldn’t exhibit any additional reactions?
target: Num ita sit, ultra quinque metra et cum pluribus impedimentis, ut armatura nullas reactiones additas ostenderet?

source: Lumian speculated as he descended floor by floor.
target: Lumian speculavit dum gradatim de tabulato descendebat.

source: After nearly half an hour, he descended to the cargo cabin at the bottom.
target: Post fere dimidiam horam, ad cellam sarcinarum in fundo descendit.

source: Before maneuvering past stacks of wooden crates, the Pride Armor in Lumian’s grasp suddenly quivered, breaking free from his control.
target: Priusquam inter acervos cistorum ligneorum se movere posset, Armatura Superbiae in manibus Lumiani repente tremuit, a potestate eius evadens.

source: The silver-white full-body armor morphed a radiant broadsword.
target: Armatura totius corporis argenteo-alba in gladium radiantem mutata est.

source: Advancing in two strides, it swung at a wooden box tucked in the corner.
target: Duobus passibus progrediens, percussit arcam ligneam in angulo absconditam.

source: With a resounding clang, the wooden box splintered, and a handful of steel ingots spilled out.
target: Magno clangore resonante, arca lignea scissa est, et copia ingotorum ferreorum effusa est.

source: At the same moment, Montserrat’s clean, youthful visage emerged from the broken box, materializing his entire body.
target: Eodem momento, vultus mundus et iuvenilis Montserrat e arca fracta emersit, corpus totum suum manifestans.

source: Confronted by the gleaming broadsword of light once more, the priest’s initially sturdy frame bulked up, as if transforming into a formidable brown bear.
target: Confrontatus iterum gladio lucis radiantis, corpus sacerdotis, quod initio robustum erat, expandit, quasi in ursum brunneum formidolosum transformaretur.

source: Bang! With a powerful palm strike, he sent the Sword of Dawn hurtling, landing atop a wooden crate of goods behind him.
target: Bang! Potenti ictu palmae, Gladius Auroris deiectus est, super arcam ligneam mercium post eum cecidens.

source: This strength rivaled that of a true giant bear!
target: Haec vis ursi veri gigantis aequipollens erat!

source: As Father Montserrat skillfully parried the Pride Armor’s onslaught, Lumian, donned in a linen shirt, black vest, and a golden straw hat, materialized swiftly beside a stack of wooden crates behind him.
target: Dum Pater Montserrat arte impetum Armaturae Superbiae paravit, Lumian, indutus tunica lintea, vestimento nigro et pileo aureo stramineo, celeriter apparuit iuxta acervum cistorum ligneorum post eum.

source: “Hmph!”
target: “Hmph!”

source: Two beams of white light shot from Lumian’s nostrils, hitting Father Montserrat before he could even react.
target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naribus Luminis emerserunt, percutientes Patrem Montserrat, antequam responderet.

source: Instantly, the priest’s gaze lost focus, and he crumpled to the ground, unconscious.
target: Statim, oculus sacerdotis evanuit, et in terram corruit, inconscus.

source: With this turn of events, vitality surged through his body like a steam engine operating at full throttle.
target: His rebus, vitalitas per corpus eius efflata est, sicut machina vaporis in plenam potentiam operans.

source: The robust vitality manifested as an incredibly potent self-healing ability, swiftly restoring Father Montserrat’s spirit.
target: Vitalitas robusta se manifestavit ut facultas sui sanationis incredibiliter potentis, celeriter spiritum Patris Montserrat restituit.

source: The Spell of Harrumph bore a resemblance to Psychic Piercing, both targeting the Spirit Body and proving challenging to defend against.
target: Incantatio Harrumph similis erat Percutio Psychica, quae utrumque corpus spiritale petens et defensionem difficilem praebens erat.

source: However, while the latter induced uncontrollable pain, trapping the target, the former added a sleep-inducing or unconscious state to the Spirit Body—a different form of harm.
target: Attamen, dum ultima dolorem incontrolabilem inducens scopa capiebat, prima vero statum soporiferum vel inconscientem corporis spiritalis addidit—forma diversa laesionis.

source: Since it was an injury, it could be healed.
target: Cum vulneratio esset, sanari poterat.

source: Empowered by the vigorous vitality’s transformation, Father Montserrat’s closed eyelids twitched as his eyeballs moved beneath them.
target: Impulsus transformatione vitalitatis vigoris, palpebra clausa Patris Montserrat concitatae sunt, dum oculi eius sub ipsis moverentur.

source: He nearly woke up before hitting the ground!
target: Paene evigilavit antequam terram attingeret!

source: Yet, for Lumian, a mere second of restraint from the Spell of Harrumph was sufficient.
target: Sed pro Lumiano, tantum unius momenti retinentia a Incantatione Harrumph suffecit.

source: Considering that Father Montserrat might also be a product of human refinement, some abilities might not be effective.
target: Considerans quod Pater Montserrat etiam ex cultu humano factum esse possit, quaedam facultates fortasse non efficaciter operabuntur.

source: Lumian lunged at him, extending his right hand.
target: Lumian ad eum impetum fecit, dextram manum protendens.

source: In his open palm, crimson flames coiled and compressed, forming a solid-looking sphere.
target: In palma aperta eius, flammas rubras convolutae et compressae sunt, quae sphaeram solidam speciei formabant.

source: Simultaneously, the Pride Armor raised the Sword of Dawn once more.
target: Simul, Armatura Superbiae iterum Gladium Auroris elevavit.

source: Just as Father Montserrat opened his eyes and instinctively regained balance, he caught sight of Louis Berry’s jade-green eyes, the dangerous crimson fireball almost white, and the broadsword of light slashing toward his head from the corner of his vision.
target: Modo quod Pater Montserrat oculos aperuisset et instanter aequilibrium recuperasset, vidit oculos Louis Berry virides sicut iaspideos, globulum ignis rubri periculosum, paene album, et gladium lucis, qui ab angulo visionis ad caput eius stridens accedebat.

source: With only a moment to react, he twisted to the side to evade the Sword of Dawn, but Lumian pressed the crimson, nearly white fireball against him.
target: Unius momenti ad reactum, se ad latus vertit ut Gladium Auroris evaderet, sed Lumian globulum ignis rubri, paene album, contra eum pressit.

source: Boom!
target: Boom!

source: In a resounding explosion, Father Montserrat was sent hurtling through the air.
target: In clamorosa explosione, Pater Montserrat per aerem impellitus est.

source: Flesh and blood erupted from his right shoulder to his abdomen, bones fractured, and squirming internal organs were laid bare.
target: Caro et sanguis e humero dextro ad abdominis partem eruptae sunt, ossa fracta sunt, atque viscera interna, quasi motantia, patefacta sunt.

source: His right arm dangled, on the verge of detachment.
target: Brachium dextum eius pendebat, abscissioni adpropinquans.

source: Yet, the robust vitality within Father Montserrat persisted. Flesh and blood wriggled within the gaping wound, miraculously healing.
target: Attamen, robusta vitalitas in Patre Montserrat persistit. Caro et sanguis in vulnere ingenti contorquebantur, mirabiliter sanantes.

source: Thud!
target: Thud!

source: Father Montserrat crashed to the ground, accompanied by the heavy footsteps of the Pride Armor and the luminous slash of the broadsword.
target: Pater Montserrat in terram corruit, comitatus gravibus vestigiis Armaturae Superbiae et fulgenti ictu gladii lucis.

source: Lifting his finger, the blood and flesh expelled from his body during the explosion swiftly coalesced, transforming into a blurry, thin blood-colored figure.
target: Digitum levans, sanguis et caro ab corpore eius durante explosione celeriter coalescebant, transformantes in figuram tenui, nebulosam, sanguine colore tinctam.

source: This figure lunged at the silver-white full-body armor, enveloping it and infiltrating its form.
target: Haec figura ad armaturam totius corporis argenteo-albam impetum fecit, eam amplectens et in formam eius infiltrans.

source: Abruptly, the cargo hold was bathed in Sunrise Gleam. The blood-colored figure dissolved, gradually fading away.
target: Subito, cella sarcinarum Splendore Aurorae inundata est. Figura sanguine colore tincta dissoluta est, paulatim evanescens.

source: The Sunrise Gleam was gentle, sparing Father Montserrat the instinctive need to shut his eyes. Consequently, his gaze reflected crimson, nearly white flaming ravens.
target: Splendor Aurorae mitis erat, Patrem Montserrat a necessitate instinctiva oculos claudendi liberans. Consequenter, aspectus eius corvos rubro, paene album, flammantes repraesentabat.

source: A dozen or so Fire Ravens circled Lumian, who casually kept one hand in his pocket.
target: Circiter duodecim corvi ignis circa Luminum volitabant, qui leviter unam manum in sinum tenebat.

source: Their eyes fixed on Montserrat, tracing distinct trajectories as they soared.
target: Oculi eorum in Montserrat incumbebant, trajectorias diversas delineantes dum volitabant.

source: Their aim was clear—to shred the target’s body and set each piece of flesh ablaze, preventing recovery even with his potent self-healing abilities.
target: Propositum eorum manifestum erat—corpus scopum scindere et singulae particulae carnis incendere, ne regeneratio quidem fieret, etiamsi potentissima facultas sui sanationis esset.

source: When each fragment was spaced 20 to 30 centimeters apart, their self-healing powers struggled to reunite them!
target: Cum singula fragmenta inter se spatia 20 ad 30 centimetra habebant, potentiae sui sanationis eos congregare vix poterant!

source: This wasn’t flesh and blood magic!
target: Haec non erat magia carnis et sanguinis!

source: Father Montserrat’s pupils dilated, and his mouth instinctively opened, emitting a sinister yet intimate voice.
target: Pupillae Patris Montserrat dilatatae sunt, et os eius instinctive aperuit, vocem sinistram sed intimam edens.

source: With the accompanying voice, a dense darkness descended, and wheat‐filled weeds sprouted, devouring the Sunrise Gleam that bathed the warehouse.
target: Cum voce comitante, densus tenebrae descendit, et herbae, triticeis plenae, germinabant, devorantes Splendorem Aurorae, quod horreum inundabat.

source: In the darkness, some of the crimson, nearly white Fire Ravens lost their way, unable to traverse the “distant” space. Gradually, they dissipated—only a fraction successfully reaching Father Montserrat.
target: In tenebris, nonnulli corvi ignis rubri, paene albi, viam amiserunt, neque spatio remotum transire potuerunt. Paulatim dissipaverunt—tantum fractio feliciter ad Patrem Montserrat perveniens.

source: Amidst thunderous explosions, Father Montserrat’s form turned translucent, giving rise to a colossal illusory oak tree in its place.
target: Inter tonitruosas explosiones, forma Patris Montserrat translucida facta est, et loco eius ingens quercus illusorius ortus est.

source: The oak tree stood unscathed amid the explosion and flames, and amidst the aftermath, the mangled form of Father Montserrat materialized on a branch adorned with mistletoe. He cradled his arms, as if holding an invisible infant.
target: Quercus illusorius, in medio explosionis et flammarum, intactus stetit, et inter reliquias, forma laniata Patris Montserrat in ramo, visco ornato, apparuit. Brachia sua fovebat, quasi infantem invisibilem amplectens.

source: Gazing at Lumian, he wore a genuine smile.
target: Ad Luminum spectans, verum risum gerebat.

source: So you’re not a demigod…
target: Ergo non es semideus…

source: “Waaa!”
target: “Waaa!”

source: For the first time, Lumian heard the ethereal, hollow cry of the baby.
target: Primum, Lumian auscultavit vocem aetheriam, cavum infantis.

source: “Wah wah wah!”
target: “Wah wah wah!”

source: Amidst the relentless cries, Lumian felt his vitality draining away. Gradually weakening, even his consciousness began to waver.
target: Inter incessantes clamores, Lumian sensit vitalitatem suam defluere. Paulatim infirmatus, etiam conscientia eius vacillare coepit.

source: The depleted vitality seemed to flow towards the invisible baby in Father Montserrat’s embrace, transforming into its nourishment.
target: Vitalitas exhausta videbatur fluere ad infantem invisibilem in amplexu Patris Montserrat, in eius nutrimentum transformans.
